# C09 design: CV pipeline (Python) and clip cutting

Covers the screens of CV05 (pitch calibration), CV11 (clips, on the match page only), NFR01 (time to review-ready, shown in the Lab) and the v0 gate's recall measure (Q-046), plus NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 on every surface. The pipeline itself has no UI. Builds on D02 Surface 7 (the Lab inside the shell), C06 (match pages, marker tool) and C07 (processing panel).

Surfaces:

1. Lab sub-navigation: `(app)/lab/layout.tsx` + `LabNav`
2. Lab matches list, extended: `/lab/matches`
3. Match benchmark view (new): `/lab/matches/[matchId]`
4. Pitch calibration tool (new): `/lab/matches/[matchId]/calibration`
5. Benchmark across model versions (new): `/lab/benchmark`
6. Match page processing step "Cutting clips": `/matches/[matchId]` (club-facing)

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **Earlier rules still apply (D01, D02, C01 to C07).** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Set text with the type classes only (`heading-1`, `heading-2`, `display-xl`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`, `eyebrow`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule (2px `focus`, 2px offset).
- **Who.** Surfaces 1 to 5 are for Wideline staff with `platform_admin` only, on a laptop or desktop at 1280. Phones must work (axe and layout at 375 and 768) but are not the main device. Surface 6 is for coaches and club admins (C07).
- **Roles.** The Lab layout calls `requirePageRole(LAB_ROLES)`; every Lab page calls it again, and every Lab action and the clip route use `withRole(LAB_ROLES)`. Anyone else goes to `/forbidden` (C01 copy, `ForbiddenState`). An unknown match or clip id is `notFound()` (404 on the route).
- **Theme.** The Lab content area is forced dark by the layout's `ThemeScope theme="dark"` (D02 Surface 7). Every Lab colour below is the dark value of its token; nothing in C09 sets `data-theme` itself. Surface 6 follows the page theme.
- **Children's data.** The Lab shows no player names. Tracks and events appear as counts, sides (`TeamMarker` with the team name) and times only. Tag imports carry no names. Nothing goes to `localStorage`.
- **Numbers.**
  - Rates: `formatRate(matched, total)` in `src/lib/labels.ts`, **whole percent rounded down** (`Math.floor(100 * m / t)`), so a recall of 94.6% shows **94%** and never reads as meeting 95%. `total = 0` gives no rate.
  - Every rate carries its sample in the same cell: **82% · 9 of 11**. The sample is `caption text-ink-muted` on its own line in table cells, and inline after ` · ` in sentences and cards.
  - Small sample (Q-048): per match, fewer than 10 tags of that type; on the benchmark page, fewer than 3 matches or fewer than 10 tags of that type. Show `span.wl-stat__sample.wl-stat__sample--small` (`warning`) under the sample: **Small sample · {n} tagged** (benchmark: **Small sample · {n} matches** when the match count is the reason). The rate and the target verdict still show.
  - Counts use `formatCount` (**48,210**). Video times use `formatVideoTime(ms, 1)` (**47:12.4**) in `data` with `tabular-nums`. Durations use `formatEta(sec)` (**3 h 42 min**, **48 min**). Dates use `formatDate` / `formatDateTime`.
  - Confidence is `ConfidenceMeter` (number in `data`) with the event type's auto-accept threshold from the job's `metadata.thresholds`.
- **The v0 target.** Goal and shot recall of 95% or more (Q-046). Shown as words plus an icon, never colour alone (NFR27): `span.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--ok` with `Check` **Meets 95%**, or `.wl-inline-status--warn` with `TriangleAlert` **Below 95%**. Shot on target and touch have no target: `Missing`.
- **Synthetic runs.** A job whose detector version starts with `synthetic` always shows the chip `StatusChip tone="neutral" icon={FlaskConical}` **Synthetic** next to its model version, so a synthetic result never reads as a model result.
- **Missing values** are `Missing` (en dash, `ink-muted`) in tables; in sentences the part is left out.
- **Copy.** Sentence case, British and South African spelling, *match*, *pitch*, *shot on target*, *goal area*, *penalty box*, *kickoff*. No exclamation marks, no emoji, no hype. Lab staff may see worker warnings and `errorMessage` (redacted, no URLs) verbatim; club users never do.
- **Motion.** 150ms ease-out on hovers and toggles. Nothing spins (`LoaderCircle` static). Overlay points and lines move instantly; no transitions on the still.
- **Loading.** Add `lab/matches/[matchId]/loading.tsx` (`DetailSkeleton`), `lab/matches/[matchId]/calibration/loading.tsx` (`WorkspaceSkeleton`) and `lab/benchmark/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`). `/lab/matches` keeps `lab/loading.tsx`. Errors fall to `(app)/error.tsx`.

### Chip preset: `JOB_STATES` in `components/ui/StatusChip.tsx`

`JobStatusChip({ status, attempts })`, exported from `components/ui/index.ts`. Add one fixture per state to the `/dev/components` StatusChip group.

| State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `queued`, attempts 0 | neutral | `CircleDashed` | Queued |
| `queued`, attempts ≥ 1 | warn | `RotateCcw` | Retrying |
| `running` | neutral | `LoaderCircle` | Running |
| `succeeded` | ok | `Check` | Succeeded |
| `failed` | danger | `CircleAlert` | Failed |

A running job past its first attempt adds `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **attempt {n} of {max}** after the chip.

### Model version text

`ProcessingJob.modelVersion` is `{detector}+{tracker}+{events}`. Lists show the detector part only (`span.data`, for example **synthetic-1**, **rfdetr-base-1.2.0**). Detail views show all three on separate lines in a `dl` (**Detector**, **Tracker**, **Events**). No model version yet: `Missing`.

### CSS: append a C09 block to `web/src/styles/components.css`

Header comment: `/* CV Lab benchmark and calibration for C09 (docs/build/design/C09.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. */`. The design system has no image-annotation component; `.wl-calib*` is specified here from tokens.

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-tabs a[aria-current="true"]` | Same as `[aria-current="page"]`: `color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--pitch);`. Used for the Matches tab on pages under `/lab/matches/…`. |
| `.wl-calib` | The still well. `position: relative; background: var(--surface-sunken); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: var(--wl-aspect);` (`--wl-aspect` is data: `{imageWidth} / {imageHeight}`, set inline). `cursor: crosshair; touch-action: none;` |
| `.wl-calib__img` | `display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; user-select: none; pointer-events: none;` |
| `.wl-calib__overlay` | `position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;` The SVG; `viewBox="0 0 {imageWidth} {imageHeight}"`, `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"`, matching the image. |
| `.wl-calib__line` | Projected pitch lines. `fill: none; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linecap: round;` |
| `.wl-calib__line--current` | The stored calibration: `stroke: var(--chalk); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6 4; paint-order: stroke;` drawn twice, first as a halo (`stroke: var(--surface-sunken); stroke-width: 3.5`, no dash), so it reads on grass and on painted lines. |
| `.wl-calib__line--fit` | The live fit from the placed points: `stroke: var(--pitch); stroke-width: 2;` with the same `surface-sunken` halo at 4. |
| `.wl-calib__point circle` | `fill: var(--pitch); stroke: var(--surface-sunken); stroke-width: 1.5; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; cursor: grab;` Visual radius 10px, set in user units from the rendered scale (`10 / scale`). |
| `.wl-calib__point text` | The point number: `fill: var(--on-pitch); font: 500 11px var(--font-mono);` in user units the same way, centred (`text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central`). `pointer-events: none`. |
| `.wl-calib__point[data-selected="true"] circle` | `fill: var(--floodlight); stroke: var(--surface-sunken);` text `fill: var(--on-floodlight)`. The one floodlight use on the still. |
| `.wl-calib__hit` | A transparent circle per point under the visible one: radius 22px visual on `(pointer: coarse)` (44px target), 12px otherwise. `fill: transparent`. |
| `.wl-calib__message` | Over the well when the still cannot show: as `.wl-videoplayer__message` (C07): centred column, `gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-4); background: var(--surface-sunken); color: var(--ink);` |
| `.wl-calib__points` | The points list (`ol`): `display: flex; flex-direction: column;` Each `li` is a `fieldset` with `border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin: 0; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-2); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); align-items: end;` The legend spans the row (`float: left; width: 100%; grid-column: 1 / -1`, as `.wl-lineup__row`); the Landmark field spans the row; X, Y and Remove share the next row. |
| `.wl-calib__points li[data-selected="true"]` | `background: var(--pitch-soft); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--pitch);` (bar plus fill; the legend also says **selected**). |
| `.wl-calib__map` | The landmark mini-map: `.wl-pitch` with `max-width: 100%`. Landmarks: unused `circle` `fill: none; stroke: var(--chalk); stroke-width: .6`; used `fill: var(--chalk)`; selected `fill: var(--floodlight); stroke: var(--on-floodlight)`. Labels use the existing `.dot-label` rule. |

## Surface 1: Lab sub-navigation, `(app)/lab/layout.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Platform admins, at a desk. One job: move between the match list and the cross-model benchmark.

**Structure.** `LabNav` (client, `web/src/app/(app)/lab/LabNav.tsx`, `usePathname()`), rendered by the layout inside the `ThemeScope`, before `children`; children sit in a `div.mt-6`. `nav.wl-tabs aria-label="CV Lab"` with two `Link`s in `body-strong`, no icons (as `AdminNav`):

| Tab | Href | `aria-current` |
|---|---|---|
| **Matches** | `/lab/matches` | `"page"` on `/lab/matches`; `"true"` on any `/lab/matches/…` page |
| **Benchmark** | `/lab/benchmark` | `"page"` on `/lab/benchmark` |

**Layout.** Same at 375, 768 and 1280: two tabs on one row (`overflow-x: auto` already on `.wl-tabs`), 40px tall; under 768px each link gets `min-height: 44px` from `.wl-tabs a` plus padding (add `@media (max-width: 767px) { .wl-tabs a { height: 44px; } }` in the C09 block).

**Keyboard and screen readers.** Links, not ARIA tabs (each is a URL). They are the first focusable items in the Lab content area. `aria-current` carries the state; the `pitch` bar only reinforces it.

---

## Surface 2: Lab matches list, `/lab/matches` (extended)

**Who, where, job.** Platform admins at a desk. One job: see every Lab match's footage, latest pipeline run, recall and time to review-ready, and open one.

**Data.** As today, plus per match: the latest video (status, warnings, `deletedAt`), the latest `cv` and `clips` ProcessingJobs (`status`, `attempts`, `maxAttempts`, `modelVersion`), `matchRecall` for goal and shot (tagged, matched) from `src/server/lab/recall.ts`, the tag count, and `reviewReadyDuration()`. Order: `playedAt` newest first (unchanged). No pagination in v0.

### Structure

`ListPage` header unchanged: eyebrow **CV Lab**, title **Matches**, no intro. `DataTable` caption **Matches, newest first**.

| Column | Header | Numeric | Cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| match | **Match** | no | `Link` to `/lab/matches/{id}`, class `body-strong text-pitch underline`: **{home} v {away}** (the `v` in `text-ink-muted`), then `caption text-ink-muted block` competition |
| date | **Date** | no | `formatDate(playedAt)` in `data whitespace-nowrap` |
| status | **Status** | no | `MatchStatusChip` |
| video | **Footage** | no | `FootageChip` for the latest video; footage deleted: `span.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--muted` `Trash2` **Deleted**; no video: `Missing`. (Header changes from **Video** to **Footage**, the club-side word.) |
| job | **Latest job** | no | `div.flex.flex-col.gap-1`, two rows, each `span.wl-row`: `span.label.text-ink-muted` **CV**, `JobStatusChip`, detector version in `span.data.text-ink-muted` plus the **Synthetic** chip when synthetic; then `span.label.text-ink-muted` **Clips**, `JobStatusChip`. A row with no job shows the label and `Missing`. No jobs at all: `span.text-ink-muted` **None yet**. |
| recall | **Recall** | yes | Two lines, one per type: `span.wl-inline-status` with the target icon (`--ok` `Check` / `--warn` `TriangleAlert`), `span.label` **Goal** / **Shot**, `span.data` **100%**, then `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **4 of 4**; `span.sr-only` **, meets 95% target** / **, below 95% target**. Small sample adds `span.wl-stat__sample--small.caption` **Small sample** under the line. A type with no tags: `span.label` **Shot** + `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **no tags**. Tags but no succeeded cv job: `span.text-ink-muted` **Waiting for CV**. No tags at all: `span.text-ink-muted` **No tags**. |
| ready | **Ready in** | yes | `formatEta(reviewReadyDuration)` in `data`. Over 4 h (NFR01): `span.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--warn` `Clock` + the duration + `span.sr-only` **, over the 4 h target**. Not review-ready yet: `Missing`. |

### Phone cards (under 768px)

`li.wl-card.flex.flex-col.gap-2`:

1. Row `flex items-start justify-between gap-3`: the match `Link` (`wl-link-row`, 44px) with **{home} v {away}**; `MatchStatusChip` on the right.
2. `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: `span.data` date, then **· {competition}** when set.
3. `dl.wl-facts` (label over value at this width): **Footage** (cell as above), **CV job** (chip + detector version), **Clips job** (chip), **Recall** (the two lines), **Ready in**.

### States

- **Empty.** Unchanged (D02): **No matches yet** / **Create one to upload footage and run the pipeline.**
- **Loading.** `lab/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`).
- **Error / forbidden.** `(app)/error.tsx`; `/forbidden`.
- **Partial data.** Each column falls back on its own (`Missing`, **None yet**, **No tags**, **Waiting for CV**); one missing part never hides the row.
- **Failed job.** The `Failed` chip; the reason is on the match benchmark view.
- **Long content.** Team names and competitions wrap; long version strings wrap (`break-all` on the version span); the table scrolls in its focusable region.
- **Small sample.** As the rules: the flag under the recall line.

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: Lab tabs, the table region (focusable, named by its caption), then each match link in row order. Phone: each card's link. Chips and statuses carry words; the target icon has its sr-only phrase.

## Surface 3: match benchmark view, `/lab/matches/[matchId]` (new)

**Who, where, job.** Platform admins at a desk, after a pipeline run or a tag import. One job: show how well the pipeline found this match's tagged events, where it missed, and why (the run's facts), and take a new set of hand tags.

**Access and data.** `requirePageRole(LAB_ROLES)`. `getMatch`, the latest video, the latest `cv` job (any status) and its `clips` job, `matchRecall(events, tags, tolerance)` per type over the events of the latest **succeeded** cv job, the missed tags and unmatched detections with each event's `Clip` (id, `deletedAt`), the match's tag counts per source, the video's `PitchCalibration`, and `reviewReadyDuration()`. Metadata title: **Match benchmark**.

### Structure (`DetailPage`)

- back **Matches** (`/lab/matches`).
- eyebrow **CV Lab · Match benchmark**.
- title `fixtureText`.
- meta **{formatMatchDate} · {competition} · {venue}** (missing parts left out).
- badges: `MatchStatusChip`; `FootageChip` (or **Deleted** as Surface 2); **Synthetic** chip when the cv job is synthetic.
- actions: `ButtonLink secondary` **Calibrate pitch** (`Crosshair`) → `/lab/matches/{id}/calibration`. Shown only when a still exists (Surface 4); otherwise left out. The page's one primary is **Import tags** in the last section.
- notice: an always-rendered `div[aria-live="polite"]` for `?done=calibrated`: `Banner tone="ok"` **Calibration saved. This match's positions are re-projected, and later matches at this venue and camera use it.**
- sections, in this order: **Recall**, **Missed tags**, **Unmatched detections**, **Run**, **Import tags**. Each `section` `mt-8`, h2 `heading-2` `tabIndex={-1}` with an `id` (`recall`, `missed`, `unmatched`, `run`, `import`).

### Section: Recall

`DataTable` caption **Recall by event type**:

| Column | Header | Numeric | Cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| type | **Event** | no | `body-strong` **Goal**, **Shot**, **Shot on target**, **Touch** (rows in this order) |
| tagged | **Tagged** | yes | count |
| found | **Detected** | yes | count of the job's events of that type (shot on target: shots with `onTarget`) |
| recall | **Recall** | yes | **82%**, then `caption text-ink-muted` **9 of 11**; small-sample flag under it |
| precision | **Precision** | yes | **90%**, then **9 of 10** |
| auto | **Auto-accepted recall** | yes | **64%**, then **7 of 11** |
| target | **v0 target** | no | **Meets 95%** / **Below 95%** for goal and shot; `Missing` for the others |

Under the table, `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-3`: **A detection counts when it is the same type and within 2 s of a tag (goals and shots) or 1 s (touches), each tag matched once. Recall counts every detection of the latest CV run, whatever its review status. Auto-accepted recall counts only detections at or above the auto-accept threshold: goal {0.90}, shot {0.75}, touch {0.60}.** (Thresholds from the job's `metadata.thresholds`, two decimals in `data`.)

Phone (under 768px): cards, one per event type, `li.wl-card`: row `flex justify-between`: `body-strong` type, target status on the right; then `dl.wl-facts`: **Tagged**, **Detected**, **Recall** (**82% · 9 of 11**), **Precision**, **Auto-accepted recall**; small-sample flag last.

| State | Content |
|---|---|
| No tags, cv succeeded | `EmptyState art={false}` title **No tags yet**, body **Import hand-tagged events to measure recall for this match.** action `Link` (`body text-pitch underline wl-link-row`) **Go to Import tags** → `#import` (moves focus to that h2). |
| Tags, cv not succeeded yet (queued, running) | The table with Tagged filled; Detected, Recall, Precision, Auto-accepted recall `Missing`; above it `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Recall appears once the CV job has finished.** |
| Tags, latest cv job failed, an earlier one succeeded | The table from the earlier succeeded job; above it `Banner tone="warn"` **The latest CV run failed. These numbers are from the run on {formatDateTime(finishedAt)}.** |
| No cv job ever succeeded, no tags | `EmptyState art={false}` title **Nothing to measure yet**, body **Recall needs a finished CV run and hand tags for this match.** |
| A type with 0 tagged | Recall `Missing`, target `span.text-ink-muted` **No tags** |
| A type with 0 detected | Precision `Missing` |

### Section: Missed tags

Tags with no matching detection. `p.body.text-ink-muted` intro: **Hand tags the pipeline did not find.** Then `DataTable` caption **Missed tags, goals and shots first**:

| Column | Header | Cell |
|---|---|---|
| time | **Video time** | `formatVideoTime(ms, 1)` in `data` |
| type | **Event** | **Goal**, **Shot**, **Shot on target** (a shot tag with `onTarget`), **Touch** |
| side | **Side** | `TeamMarker` with the team name; `teamSide` blank: `Missing` |
| nearest | **Nearest detection** (numeric) | the closest event of the same type: **{time} · {s} s away** (`data`, one decimal), or `Missing` |

Order: goals, shots, touches, each by time. At most 100 rows; with more, under the table `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Showing the first 100 of {n} missed tags.** Phone: cards `li.wl-card` with a `wl-row`: time (`data`), type (`body-strong`), `TeamMarker`; then `p.caption` the nearest detection.

Empty (tags exist, none missed): `p.body` with `span.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--ok` `Check` **Every tag was found.** Section hidden when there are no tags or no succeeded cv job (the Recall section already says why).

### Section: Unmatched detections

Detections that match no tag. Intro `p.body.text-ink-muted`: **Events the pipeline found that no hand tag matches.** `DataTable` caption **Unmatched detections, goals and shots first**:

| Column | Header | Cell |
|---|---|---|
| time | **Video time** | `formatVideoTime(ms, 1)` |
| type | **Event** | as above |
| side | **Side** | `TeamMarker`, or `Missing` for `unknown` |
| confidence | **Confidence** | `ConfidenceMeter score threshold` (the type's threshold; not `detail`) |
| status | **Status** | `EventStatusChip` |
| clip | **Clip** | see below |

Clip cell:

| Clip | Content |
|---|---|
| exists, not deleted | `a` (`body text-pitch underline wl-link-row`) **Open clip** + `ExternalLink` icon, `href="/lab/clips/{clipId}"`, `target="_blank" rel="noopener"`; `aria-label` **Open clip of {type} at {time} (opens in a new tab)** |
| clips job queued or running, no clip yet | `span.text-ink-muted` **Being cut** |
| `deletedAt` set | `span.text-ink-muted` **Clip deleted** |
| none and the clips job failed | `Missing` |

Same order, 100-row cap (**Showing the first 100 of {n} unmatched detections.**) and phone cards (row: time, type, chip; then `TeamMarker`, the meter and the clip link). Empty: `span.wl-inline-status--ok` `Check` **Every detection matches a tag.**

The clip route answers 302 to a 60 s presigned GET of the MP4; the browser's own player opens it in the new tab. If the link has gone stale (404), the browser shows the app's not-found page.

### Section: Run

Facts about the latest cv job. A grid `div.grid.gap-6` (1 column; 2 from 768px; 3 from 1280px) of three `div.wl-card`s, each with h3 `body-strong` and a `dl.wl-facts.mt-3` (`dt.label`, `dd.body`, numbers in `data`):

**Card 1, h3 Pipeline**

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| **CV job** | `JobStatusChip` (+ **attempt {n} of {max}**) |
| **Detector** / **Tracker** / **Events** | the three version parts in `data`; **Synthetic** chip after the detector when synthetic |
| **Finished** | `formatDateTime(finishedAt)`, or `Missing` |
| **Speed** | **{realtimeFactor} × real time** (two decimals) |
| **GPU start-up** | `formatEta(startupMs / 1000)`; synthetic or docker runs: `Missing` |
| **Clips job** | `JobStatusChip`, then `caption text-ink-muted` **{count} clips · {formatSize(bytes)} · {formatEta(cutMs / 1000)}** when succeeded |
| **Ready in** | **{formatEta} after upload** + the 4 h status (`--ok` `Check` **Within 4 h target** / `--warn` `Clock` **Over 4 h target**); not ready: **Not ready yet** |
| **Last error** | failed jobs only: `p.data.break-words` the redacted `errorMessage` |

**Card 2, h3 Tracks and events**

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| **Tracks kept** | count |
| **Linked to players** | count |
| **Discarded at the consent check** | count |
| **Unlinked** | count |
| **Position points** | `formatCount` |
| **Events** | **{n}** then `caption text-ink-muted` **{a} auto-accepted · {p} pending review** |
| **Sides** | `teamSideSwapped` true: **Swapped to match shirt numbers ({n} reads)**; evidence but no swap: **Kept as detected ({n} reads)**; no reads: `span.wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert` **Not confirmed: no readable shirt numbers** |

**Card 3, h3 Pitch calibration**

| Calibration | Content |
|---|---|
| manual | **Source** **Manual**; **Error** **{reprojectionErrorM} m** (one decimal); **Points** **{pointCount}**; **Confidence** `ConfidenceMeter` with threshold 0.5 (`detail`); **Saved** `formatDateTime(createdAt)`; when reused from another video: `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Reused from an earlier match at this venue and camera.** |
| fallback | **Source** `span.wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert` **Not calibrated**; **Confidence** meter (low); `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Positions are approximate until a platform admin calibrates this venue.** |
| none (no cv run yet) | `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Not calibrated yet.** |

Then, when a still exists, `ButtonLink secondary sm` **Calibrate pitch** (`Crosshair`) at the card's foot (the same link as the hero action, for the reader who arrives here).

**Warnings**, full width under the grid, only when `metadata.warnings` is non-empty: h3 `body-strong` **Warnings ({n})**, `ul.wl-issues.mt-3`, each `li.wl-issues__warn` with `TriangleAlert` and `p.body` the warning text verbatim (worker English, for example **ball not visible for 142s total**).

| State | Content |
|---|---|
| No cv job | The three cards replaced by `p.body.text-ink-muted` **The CV job has not been queued yet. It starts when the footage is accepted.** |
| cv queued or running | Card 1 filled as far as known; cards 2 and 3 show `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Counts appear when the run finishes.** |
| cv failed | Card 1 with **Failed** and **Last error**; cards 2 and 3 from the last succeeded run if any, with `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **From the run on {formatDateTime}.**; otherwise as running |

### Section: Import tags

`form` (client, `useFormAction`, `noValidate`, `encType="multipart/form-data"`), `max-w-2xl`, inside `div.wl-card`. Intro `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Hand-tagged events are the ground truth for recall. Importing replaces this match's tags from the same source.** Then current counts, `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: **Now: {n} hand tags · {m} synthetic tags · {k} SoccerNet tags** (sources with 0 left out; none at all: **No tags yet.**).

Fields (`Field`, label `label`, hint `caption`):

1. **Source**: `select.wl-input name="source"`: **Hand-tagged** (`hand`, default), **Synthetic truth** (`synthetic`), **SoccerNet labels** (`soccernet`). Hint **Tags from other sources stay as they are.**
2. **CSV file**: `input.wl-input.wl-file type="file" accept=".csv,text/csv" name="file"`. Hint **Up to 2,000 rows and 1 MB.**
3. **Or paste CSV**: `textarea.wl-input.data name="csv" rows={8} spellCheck={false} autoComplete="off"` (height auto). Hint **Use one or the other.**
4. `details.mt-2` `summary.label` **CSV format**: `p.body` **Columns: type, time, teamSide, onTarget. The first row is the header. type is goal, shot or touch. time is the video time as 47:12.4 or in ms. teamSide is home, away or blank. onTarget is true, false or blank, for shots only. A goal is also a shot: tag both.** then `pre.data.wl-card` (on `surface-sunken`, `overflow-x: auto`):

   ```
   type,time,teamSide,onTarget
   goal,12:04.2,home,
   shot,12:03.8,home,true
   shot,31:40.0,away,false
   touch,31:38.6,,
   ```

5. `FormErrorBanner`, then the row errors (below).
6. `SubmitButton` primary **Import tags** (`Upload` icon), pending **Importing…**. The page's one primary. Under 768px `block` (48px, full width).

**Replace confirmation.** When the chosen source already has tags, the submit opens `ConfirmDialog`: title **Replace {n} {source word} tags?** (**hand**, **synthetic**, **SoccerNet**), body **Importing replaces this match's {source word} tags. Recall is worked out again from the new ones.**, submit primary **Replace tags** (pending **Importing…**), and **Cancel**. Focus starts on Cancel (ConfirmDialog rule).

**Success.** `SuccessBanner` above the form (live region): **Imported {n} tags: {g} goals, {s} shots, {t} touches. Recall is updated.** (zero types left out; one: **1 goal**). The form resets; the page data refreshes (`router.refresh()` after the action's `revalidatePath`), so the Recall section shows new numbers.

**Errors.** Nothing is imported when any row fails (one transaction). Form-level, in `FormErrorBanner`:

| Case | Copy |
|---|---|
| neither file nor paste | **Choose a CSV file or paste CSV.** (field error on **CSV file**) |
| both | **Choose a file or paste CSV, not both.** |
| file over 1 MB | **The file is larger than 1 MB.** |
| not text | **This file is not a CSV file.** |
| wrong header | **The first row must be the header type,time,teamSide,onTarget.** |
| no rows | **There are no rows after the header.** |
| over 2,000 rows | **The CSV has {formatCount(n)} rows. Import at most 2,000 at a time.** |
| row errors | **{n} rows have errors. Fix them and import again.** |
| server failure | **We could not import the tags. Try again.** |

Row errors: under the banner, `ul.wl-issues.mt-3`, each `li.wl-issues__reject` with `X` and `p.body`, at most 20, then `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **and {n} more rows with errors.**:

- **Row {r}: type must be goal, shot or touch.**
- **Row {r}: time "{value}" is not a time like 47:12.4 or a number of ms.** (value cut to 20 characters)
- **Row {r}: time is past the end of the video ({formatVideoTime(duration, 1)}).**
- **Row {r}: teamSide must be home, away or blank.**
- **Row {r}: onTarget must be true, false or blank.**
- **Row {r}: onTarget is for shots only.**
- **Row {r}: has {n} columns. Each row needs 4.**

`r` counts the header as row 1, so it matches a spreadsheet's row number.

**Footage deleted.** Import still works (tags are times, not footage).

### Layout

- **375.** Hero stacks (title `heading-1`); Calibrate pitch full width under the badges. Recall, missed and unmatched as cards. Run cards in one column. The import form full width, Import tags `block`.
- **768.** Tables replace cards (each in its scroll region). Run cards in 2 columns (Pitch calibration wraps to the second row). Form `max-w-2xl`.
- **1280.** Content column `max-w-7xl`. Run cards in 3 columns. Tables at natural width; nothing scrolls sideways at this width.

### States (page)

- **Loading.** `DetailSkeleton`.
- **Not found.** Unknown match id or another organisation's (scoped client): `notFound()`.
- **Forbidden.** Layout guard: `/forbidden`.
- **Error.** `(app)/error.tsx`. A failing `matchRecall` alone is not caught separately: the page fails as one.
- **Long content.** Hundreds of touches: the 100-row caps. Long warnings and errors wrap (`break-words`).

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: Lab tabs, back link, **Calibrate pitch**, then each section in order: Recall table region; Missed tags region; Unmatched region with its **Open clip** links; the Pitch calibration card's link; the import form (Source, CSV file, Or paste CSV, CSV format, Import tags).
- Section h2s are `section aria-labelledby` landmarks. **Go to Import tags** and any `#…` link move focus to the target h2.
- Row errors: after a failed import, focus moves to the `FormErrorBanner` (it is `role="alert"`), then Tab reaches the first field. `useFocusFirstInvalid` handles the field-level case.
- `ConfidenceMeter` already speaks **Confidence 0.58, under auto-accept threshold**. `TeamMarker` speaks **Home side: {team}**.
- No shortcuts on this page.

## Surface 4: pitch calibration tool, `/lab/matches/[matchId]/calibration` (new)

**Who, where, job.** A platform admin, once per venue and camera, on a laptop with a mouse (a phone works through the number fields, slowly). One job: place 4 to 12 pitch landmarks on a still from the match so stored positions map to the 105 × 68 m pitch (CV05, Q-042).

**Access and data.** `requirePageRole(LAB_ROLES)`. The still from the latest cv attempt (a 15-minute presigned GET of `cv/{jobId}/attempt-{n}/still.jpg`), its `imageWidth` × `imageHeight`, the video's current `PitchCalibration` (homography, source, error, point count, created), `venueKey` and `cameraKey`, the match's TrackPoint and Event counts (for the confirm text), and `PITCH_LANDMARKS`. The page draws pitch lines through `applyHomography()` (inverse of the stored H) and fits live with `fitHomography()` from `src/lib/homography.ts`. Metadata title: **Pitch calibration**.

### Structure

1. `PageHeader`: back **Match benchmark** (`/lab/matches/{id}`); eyebrow **CV Lab · {fixtureText}**; title **Pitch calibration**; intro **Place at least 4 pitch landmarks on the still. Spread them across the pitch: corners, box corners and the halfway line work best.**
2. `p.body.mt-4` the current state (one line): manual **Current: manual calibration, {error} m error from {n} points, saved {formatDate}.**; fallback **Current: not calibrated. Positions are approximate.** (with `span.wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert` before the sentence); then, when there is no venue, `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **This match has no venue, so later matches cannot reuse this calibration.**; else **Applies to later matches at {venue} filmed at {width} × {height}.**
3. `Workspace` (no theme prop; the Lab is already dark), `primary` **Still**, `side` **Landmarks**. Side by side from 1280 (8 and 4 columns), stacked below.

**Still pane.**

- `div.wl-calib` (`style={{"--wl-aspect": ...}}`), `img.wl-calib__img` with `alt` **Still from the match footage at {formatVideoTime(stillMs, 0)}**, then `svg.wl-calib__overlay` `role="img"` `aria-label` **Pitch lines drawn over the still: dashed for the current calibration, solid for the new fit. {n} points placed.** (left out parts that do not exist). Inside: the current lines (`.wl-calib__line--current`: outline, halfway line, centre circle, both penalty boxes and goal areas), the fit lines (`--fit`, only with a valid fit), then one `g.wl-calib__point` per point (hit circle, circle, number).
- Legend under the well, `div.wl-legend` (wraps): a dashed `chalk` swatch **Current calibration**, a solid `pitch` swatch **New fit**. Swatches are inline SVG lines with the same classes. Items not drawn are left out.
- `div.wl-row.mt-3`: `Button secondary sm` **Add point** (`Plus`), `Button ghost sm` **Remove all points** (`Trash2`, only with 1 or more points). `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Click the still to add a point. Drag a point to move it.**

**Landmarks pane.**

1. **Fit status**, `div.wl-card` with `aria-live="polite"` (updated 500 ms after the last change):

   | Points and fit | Content |
   |---|---|
   | 0 to 3 placed | `p.body` **Place at least 4 points. {n} placed.** |
   | 4 or more, a landmark missing on any point | `p.body` **Choose a landmark for every point to see the fit.** |
   | fit fails (points in a line, or duplicate positions) | `span.wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert` **These points do not fit a pitch. Spread them out, not along one line.** |
   | error ≤ 1.5 m | `p.data` **{error} m error · {n} points**, then `span.wl-inline-status--ok` `Check` **Within the 1.5 m limit** |
   | error > 1.5 m | `p.data` **{error} m error · {n} points**, then `span.wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert` **Over the 1.5 m limit. Move or remove the points with the largest error.** |

2. `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-4` **Left and right as the camera sees the pitch. Near is the touchline closest to the camera.**
3. **Landmark map**: `svg.wl-pitch.wl-calib__map` (`viewBox="0 0 105 68"`, turf and chalk lines), a dot per landmark, the point number as `.dot-label` beside used ones. `role="img"`, `aria-label` **Pitch map: {n} of 23 landmarks used.** Decorative help; the select is the input.
4. **Points**, `ol.wl-calib__points` (`aria-label` **Points**), one `li > fieldset` per point, in placement order:
   - `legend.body-strong` **Point {n}** (+ `span.sr-only` **, selected** when selected).
   - `Field` **Landmark**: `select.wl-input` with first option **Choose a landmark** (value empty), then `optgroup`s (below). A landmark used by another point is `disabled` and its text gains **(point {m})**.
   - `Field` **X (px)** and **Y (px)**: `input.wl-input.data type="number" inputMode="numeric" step=1 min=0 max={imageWidth or imageHeight}`. ↑ / ↓ step 1 px (native); Shift + ↑ / ↓ step 10 px.
   - `span.data` **{residual} m** under the Y field once a fit exists (`caption text-ink-muted`; over 1.5 m it is `wl-inline-status--warn` with `TriangleAlert`).
   - `IconButton` `Trash2` `aria-label` **Remove point {n}**.
   Selecting a point (clicking it on the still, or focus entering its fieldset) sets `data-selected` on both the `li` and the overlay `g`.
5. `Banner tone="warn"` **Saving re-projects this match's stored positions and events, and recomputes distance covered. Positions that land off the pitch are removed.**
6. `FormErrorBanner`, then `SubmitButton` primary **Save calibration**, pending **Saving…** (the page's one primary; `block` under 768px). It opens the confirm dialog first.

**Landmark options** (`PITCH_LANDMARKS` labels; 23, in this order):

| Group | Options |
|---|---|
| **Corners** | Corner, near left · Corner, far left · Corner, near right · Corner, far right |
| **Halfway line** | Halfway line, near touchline · Halfway line, far touchline · Centre spot |
| **Left penalty box** | Left penalty box, near goal-line corner · Left penalty box, near front corner · Left penalty box, far front corner · Left penalty box, far goal-line corner |
| **Left goal area** | Left goal area, near goal-line corner · Left goal area, near front corner · Left goal area, far front corner · Left goal area, far goal-line corner |
| **Right penalty box** | as left, with **Right** |
| **Right goal area** | as left, with **Right** |

**Confirm dialog** (`ConfirmDialog`): title **Save this calibration?**, body `p.body` **This re-projects {formatCount(points)} position points and {formatCount(events)} events for this match. Points that land off the pitch are removed, and distance covered is worked out again.** plus, with a venue, `p.body` **Later matches at {venue} filmed at {width} × {height} use it from now on. The current calibration is replaced.** Submit primary **Save and re-project**, pending **Saving…**; **Cancel**.

**Success.** Redirect to `/lab/matches/{id}?done=calibrated` (Surface 3 notice).

**Errors** (server, in `FormErrorBanner`; field errors on the point's field):

| Case | Copy |
|---|---|
| fewer than 4 points | **Place at least 4 points.** |
| more than 12 | **Use at most 12 points.** |
| a point without a landmark | field: **Choose a landmark for point {n}.** |
| a landmark used twice | field: **Each landmark can be used once.** |
| x or y outside the image | field: **Enter a value from 0 to {max}.** |
| error over 1.5 m | **The error is {error} m. It must be 1.5 m or less.** |
| points do not fit | **These points do not fit a pitch. Spread them out, not along one line.** |
| venue calibration changed since the page loaded | **Someone saved a calibration for this venue since you opened this page. Reload to see it.** |
| server failure | **We could not save the calibration. Nothing was changed. Try again.** |

### Interaction rules

- **Click or tap on the still** (not on a point): adds a point at that pixel when fewer than 12 exist, selects it, and moves focus to its **Landmark** select. Image pixels come from the pointer position divided by the rendered scale, rounded to whole px.
- **Click on a point** selects it. **Drag** moves it (pointer capture, the cursor `grabbing`); X and Y update live.
- **Add point** adds a point at the centre of the image, selects it and focuses its **Landmark** select.
- **12 points:** clicks on the still do nothing, **Add point** is `disabled`, and `p.caption.text-ink-muted` under it reads **12 points is the most. Remove one to add another.**
- **Remove point** removes it, renumbers the rest, and moves focus to the **Landmark** select of the point now in that place, else the previous one, else **Add point**.
- **Remove all points** asks nothing (nothing is saved yet) and focuses **Add point**.
- Points are not preloaded: a stored calibration keeps its matrix, not its points (Q-049). The current lines show where it puts the pitch.
- Leaving with points placed and unsaved registers `beforeunload`.

### States

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| Loading | `WorkspaceSkeleton` |
| No still (no cv attempt yet, or the still upload failed) | The Workspace is replaced by `EmptyState art={false}` title **No still yet**, body **A still is saved from the footage each time the CV job runs. Run the job, then calibrate.** No action. |
| Still fails to load (`img` error, for example an expired URL) | `.wl-calib__message` over the well: `CircleAlert` (`danger`), `body-strong` **The still did not load.** `Button secondary` **Reload** (reloads the page). Points stay in the list. |
| No current calibration (fallback) | Only fit lines draw; legend shows **New fit** only |
| Footage deleted | Works as normal: the still is under `cv/`, kept until C17 removes it |
| Error / forbidden / not found | As Surface 3 |
| Long content | Venue names wrap in the intro lines. The landmark select is full width of its fieldset; option text wraps natively. |

### Layout

- **375.** Header; current state; Still pane (well full width; **Add point** and **Remove all points** wrap; inputs 44px); then Landmarks pane: fit status, note, map at full width, points (Landmark full width; X, Y and Remove on one row), the banner, Save full width. Tapping the still works, but the hit area is small at this scale; the number fields are the precise path.
- **768.** Same stack, with more room for the still. Points list in one column.
- **1280.** Still 8 columns, landmarks 4. The side pane scrolls with the page; nothing is sticky.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- **Tab order:** Lab tabs, back link, then the still pane: **Add point**, **Remove all points**; then the landmarks pane: per point Landmark, X (px), Y (px), Remove point {n}; then **Save calibration**. The still and the SVG are not focusable; the map is not focusable. Every pointer action has a keyboard equivalent (WCAG 2.5.7): add with **Add point**, move with X and Y, select by focus.
- **Shortcuts:** none beyond the number fields' arrows (Shift + arrow for 10 px).
- **Announcements**, `span.sr-only[aria-live="polite"]` in the pane: **Point {n} added at {x}, {y}. Choose its landmark.**, **Point {n} removed.**, **All points removed.** The fit status card is its own polite live region (debounced 500 ms), so a typed value announces the new error once, not per keystroke.
- **Focus on errors:** after a failed save, `useFocusFirstInvalid` moves to the first invalid field, else the banner.
- The overlay `role="img"` label states what is drawn; the points list is the accessible model of the points.

## Surface 5: benchmark across model versions, `/lab/benchmark` (new)

**Who, where, job.** Platform admins at a desk, when a new model or rule version has run on the tagged fixtures. One job: say whether each model version passes the v0 gate (goal and shot recall of 95% or more), on how much evidence.

**Data.** `benchmarkByModel()`: per `ProcessingJob.modelVersion`, over succeeded cv jobs of Lab matches with tags: the match count, the latest `finishedAt`, and per event type tagged, detected, matched and auto-accepted matched (pooled over matches). A match counts once per model version it was run with. Versions ordered by latest run, newest first. Metadata title: **Benchmark**.

### Structure

1. `ListPage` header: eyebrow **CV Lab**, title **Benchmark**, intro **Recall by model version against the v0 gate: 95% of tagged goals and shots found. Tags are pooled across matches.**
2. **Summary**, `section` h2 `heading-2` **By model version**, `DataTable` caption **Goal and shot recall by model version, latest first**:

   | Column | Header | Numeric | Cell |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | version | **Model version** | no | `a` to `#v-{slug}` (`body-strong text-pitch underline`) with the detector part, **Synthetic** chip when synthetic; under it `caption text-ink-muted` tracker and events parts |
   | matches | **Matches** | yes | count |
   | goal | **Goal recall** | yes | **96%** + `caption` **48 of 50**, small-sample flag |
   | shot | **Shot recall** | yes | **91%** + **219 of 240** |
   | gate | **v0 gate** | no | both meet: `wl-inline-status--ok` `Check` **Passes**; either below: `--warn` `TriangleAlert` **Does not pass**; goal or shot with 0 tags: `--muted` `CircleDashed` **Not enough tags** |
   | last | **Last run** | no | `formatDate` in `data` |

3. **One section per version**, `section id="v-{slug}"` `mt-8`: h2 `heading-2` the detector part (`break-all`), then `wl-row` the **Synthetic** chip when synthetic; `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **{n} matches · {t} tagged goals · {s} tagged shots · last run {formatDate}** and the full version in `data`. Then the Recall table of Surface 3, with one added column **Matches** (numeric) after **Event**, caption **Recall by event type for {detector}**. The tolerance caption from Surface 3 follows the first version section only.

Phone: Summary as cards (`li.wl-card`: version link and chip; `dl.wl-facts` Matches, Goal recall, Shot recall, v0 gate, Last run); each version's table as Surface 3's cards.

### States

| State | Content |
|---|---|
| Empty (no tagged match with a succeeded cv job) | `EmptyState` title **No benchmark results yet**, body **Import hand tags on a Lab match. Recall appears here once that match has a finished CV run.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Go to matches** → `/lab/matches` |
| Loading | `ListSkeleton` |
| Small sample | Under 3 matches: the flag **Small sample · {n} matches** under the version's caption and in its rate cells; under 10 tags of a type: **Small sample · {n} tagged** in that cell. The gate verdict still shows. |
| Only synthetic versions | Normal; the chip on each row says so |
| Long content | Many versions stack; the summary keeps them in one table. Long version strings break (`break-all`). |
| Error / forbidden | `(app)/error.tsx`; `/forbidden` |

### Layout

- **375.** Header, summary cards, then each version section with cards.
- **768.** Tables in scroll regions.
- **1280.** Tables at natural width inside `max-w-7xl`.

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: Lab tabs, the summary region and its version links (each moves focus to its section h2, `tabIndex={-1}`), then each version's table region. The gate words carry the verdict; icons are `aria-hidden`.

## Surface 6: match page processing step, `/matches/[matchId]` (Footage card)

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins (C07 Surface 2). One job: show that clips are being cut, the last step before review.

Add `clipsStep(job)` to `ProcessingPanel.tsx`, rendered third in `ol.wl-checklist`: Preparing playback, Finding events, **Cutting clips**. Same row shape, icons and `data-*` as C07.

| Job state | Icon | `data-*` | Line | Caption |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No job yet, or `queued` with `attempts = 0` | `CircleDashed` | none | **Cutting clips · Waiting to start** | **Starts once events are found.** |
| `running`, attempt 1 | `LoaderCircle` (static) | none | **Cutting clips · In progress** | **Cutting a short clip around each event.** |
| `running`, attempt n > 1 | `LoaderCircle` | `data-state="retrying"` | **Cutting clips · In progress, attempt {n} of {max}** | as C07 step 1 |
| `queued` with `attempts ≥ 1` | `RotateCcw` | `data-state="retrying"` | **Cutting clips · Trying again soon, attempt {attempts + 1} of {max}** | **The last try did not finish. We try again in a minute.** |
| `succeeded`, 1 or more clips | `Check` | `data-done="true"` | **Cutting clips · Clips ready** | **Each clip is kept for 14 days unless it is marked as a favourite.** |
| `succeeded`, 0 clips | `Check` | `data-done="true"` | **Cutting clips · Clips ready** | **No events were found, so there are no clips.** |
| `failed` | `CircleAlert` | `data-state="failed"` | **Cutting clips · Failed** | **We tried {max} times. Wideline staff have been told and will try again.** |
| `failed` with `attempts = 0` (an earlier step failed) | `CircleDashed` | none | **Cutting clips · Not started** | none |

The step row only shows when the panel shows (C07). Estimated finish copy unchanged. Keyboard, live region and layout as C07 Surface 2. No other change to the match page.

## Questions

- Q-048: small-sample thresholds for recall (10 tags per type per match; 3 matches or 10 tags per type on the benchmark). Default taken as specified.
- Q-049: stored calibrations keep only the matrix, so the tool cannot reload the points it was made from. Default: start with no points and show the current lines.
